defmodule ProxyAuth.Router do use Plug.Router require Logger plug :match plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json, :urlencoded], pass: ["*/*"], json_decoder: Jason plug :dispatch @upstream_services %{ "users" => "http://users-svc:4001", "profiles" => "http://profiles-svc:4002", "admin" => "http://admin-svc:4003" } # Cross-service auth token validation defp validate_service_token(token) do case ProxyAuth.TokenStore.verify(token) do {:ok, claims} -> {:ok, claims} {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason} end end defp sanitize_header_value(value) when is_binary(value) do value |> String.replace(~r/[\r\n]/, "") |> String.trim() end defp encode_display_name(name) when is_binary(name) do # Encode for safe transport in headers using base64 Base.url_encode64(name, padding: false) end defp decode_display_name(encoded) when is_binary(encoded) do case Base.url_decode64(encoded, padding: false) do {:ok, decoded} -> decoded :error -> encoded end end defp html_escape(text) when is_binary(text) do text |> String.replace("&", "&") |> String.replace("<", "<") |> String.replace(">", ">") |> String.replace("\"", """) |> String.replace("'", "'") end post "/proxy/authenticate" do with token <- get_req_header(conn, "x-service-token") |> List.first(), {:ok, claims} <- validate_service_token(token) do conn |> put_resp_header("x-auth-status", "valid") |> put_resp_header("x-user-id", claims["sub"]) |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "authenticated", user: claims["sub"]})) else _ -> conn |> send_resp(401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "unauthorized"})) end end # Proxy endpoint that forwards requests with user context match "/proxy/:service/*path" do service = conn.params["service"] path_segments = conn.params["path"] with token <- get_req_header(conn, "x-service-token") |> List.first(), {:ok, claims} <- validate_service_token(token), {:ok, upstream_url} <- resolve_upstream(service) do display_name = claims["display_name"] || claims["sub"] encoded_name = encode_display_name(display_name) user_id = claims["sub"] # Build upstream request with auth context target_path = Enum.join(path_segments, "/") full_url = "#{upstream_url}/#{target_path}" headers = [ {"x-authenticated-user", sanitize_header_value(user_id)}, {"x-display-name-b64", sanitize_header_value(encoded_name)}, {"x-proxy-forwarded", "true"} ] case HTTPoison.request( conn.method |> String.downcase() |> String.to_atom(), full_url, read_body_cached(conn), headers ) do {:ok, %HTTPoison.Response{status_code: status, body: body, headers: resp_headers}} -> conn |> merge_resp_headers(resp_headers) |> send_resp(status, body) {:error, _} -> conn |> send_resp(502, Jason.encode!(%{error: "upstream_error"})) end else {:error, :unknown_service} -> conn |> send_resp(404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "service_not_found"})) _ -> conn |> send_resp(401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "unauthorized"})) end end # Admin dashboard renders user activity get "/admin/activity" do with token <- get_req_header(conn, "x-service-token") |> List.first(), {:ok, claims} <- validate_service_token(token), true <- claims["role"] == "admin" do activities = ProxyAuth.ActivityLog.recent(50) html = render_activity_page(activities) conn |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> send_resp(200, html) else _ -> conn |> send_resp(403, "Forbidden") end end defp render_activity_page(activities) do rows = Enum.map(activities, fn activity -> # Display name was stored as base64 from the proxy header display_name = decode_display_name(activity.encoded_display_name) timestamp = activity.timestamp |> DateTime.to_iso8601() action = HtmlSanitizeEx.strip_tags(activity.action) safe_name = html_escape(display_name) "#{timestamp}#{safe_name}#{action}" end) |> Enum.join("\n") """ Activity Log

Recent Proxy Activity

#{rows}
TimeUserAction
""" end defp resolve_upstream(service) do case Map.get(@upstream_services, service) do nil -> {:error, :unknown_service} url -> {:ok, url} end end defp merge_resp_headers(conn, headers) do Enum.reduce(headers, conn, fn {key, value}, acc -> safe_key = String.downcase(key) if safe_key in ["transfer-encoding", "connection"] do acc else put_resp_header(acc, safe_key, value) end end) end defp read_body_cached(conn) do case Plug.Conn.read_body(conn) do {:ok, body, _} -> body _ -> "" end end end defmodule ProxyAuth.ActivityLog do use GenServer def start_link(_), do: GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, [], name: __MODULE__) def init(_), do: {:ok, []} def log_activity(encoded_display_name, action) do GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:log, encoded_display_name, action}) end def recent(n) do GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:recent, n}) end def handle_cast({:log, encoded_display_name, action}, state) do entry = %{ encoded_display_name: encoded_display_name, action: action, timestamp: DateTime.utc_now() } {:noreply, [entry | state] |> Enum.take(1000)} end def handle_call({:recent, n}, _from, state) do {:reply, Enum.take(state, n), state} end end defmodule ProxyAuth.TokenStore do def verify(nil), do: {:error, :no_token} def verify(token) do case Joken.verify_and_validate(token_config(), token, signer()) do {:ok, claims} -> {:ok, claims} {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason} end end defp token_config do Joken.Config.default_claims(skip: [:aud, :iss]) end defp signer do Joken.Signer.create("HS256", jwt_secret()) end # Require the JWT secret to be explicitly configured at runtime. # Never fall back to a hardcoded/guessable default, which would # allow attackers to forge valid tokens. defp jwt_secret do case Application.fetch_env(:proxy_auth, :jwt_secret) do {:ok, secret} when is_binary(secret) and byte_size(secret) >= 32 -> secret {:ok, secret} when is_binary(secret) -> raise "JWT secret :jwt_secret must be at least 32 bytes for HS256" _ -> raise "JWT secret not configured: set config :proxy_auth, :jwt_secret" end end end
